environment.measurementMethod: Tsukimi MCP test runner, default Udon path (steps = instructions, externs = extern calls), run minus setup
environment.note: Steps and externs are Udon instruction and extern counts from the Tsukimi test runner, not CPU time. Production sources are compiled with the reviewed stub rules in perf/harness.py.
